principle: select a visual from the analytical question, data shape and evidence contract; never from page number or visual variety
decisionOrder: fall back to a table or takeaway when a chart would mislead

hardGuards.donut: one part-to-whole series, positive values, 2-5 parts only
hardGuards.line: ordered time or another naturally ordered continuous axis
hardGuards.heatmap: two categorical dimensions and one comparable numeric measure
hardGuards.scatter: paired x/y observations; correlation is not causation
hardGuards.map: geographic comparison only; use ranked bars when precise comparison matters
hardGuards.funnel: ordered stages sharing a valid cohort and denominator
hardGuards.sankey: weighted flows whose source and destination totals reconcile
hardGuards.waterfall: additive contributions that reconcile opening to closing value
hardGuards.chart: confirmed numeric evidence with labels, units, period, statistical subject and sourceRefs
hardGuards.formula: operands, operator and result must reconcile
hardGuards.threshold: actual and boundary must use the same scale and unit
hardGuards.allocation: segments must reconcile to the declared whole
hardGuards.gap: gap must equal theoretical entitlement minus directly delivered amount
hardGuards.numbering: ordinal headings do not trigger a process unless a real order is present
hardGuards.entity: canonical source names must be preserved; unknown entities cannot be added to fill a layout

fallback.warning: No controlled page family expresses this relationship. Split the proposition or request layout review; never force it into a table.
